buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Product Requirements - The battery shall be brand new, unused and of current production. - The offered battery shall conform to all technical parameters specified in the bid.

- Refurbished, repaired, reconditioned or previously used batteries shall not be accepted. - The battery shall be supplied with proper identification, serial number and manufacturing details. 2. Compatibility Requirements - The offered battery must be fully compatible with the existing UAV NETRA system. - It must support the existing NETRA battery mounting arrangement and electrical interface. - The battery shall be compatible with the existing universal battery charger supplied with NETRA. - The battery shall support existing UAV battery health monitoring and autonomous battery failsaf e functions without generating any compatibility error. - The bidder shall submit documentary evidence establishing compatibility with NETRA. 3. Smart Battery Management System (BMS) - The battery shall have an integrated intelligent Battery Management System. - The system shall support battery health monitoring and data logging. - Battery voltage, individual cell voltage, charging/discharging current and battery temperature m onitoring shall be available. - Battery health data logging capability shall be minimum two years. - Cell balancing and battery protection functions shall operate without compatibility errors. 4. Safety Requirements - The battery shall incorporate protection against overcharging, over-discharging, over-temperature and s hort circuits. - The battery enclosure shall provide the specified ingress protection. - The battery shall be free from swelling, leakage, physical damage and manufacturing defects. - Applicable lithium battery transportation and safety standards shall be complied with. 5. Documents to be Submitted The bidder shall submit: - Detailed technical datasheet of the offered battery. - Technical compliance statement against each parameter. - Documentary evidence of NETRA compatibility. - BMS functionality and battery health monitoring details. - Applicable battery safety and transportation certificates. - Warranty undertaking from the manufacturer or supplier. 6. Inspection and Acceptance - The supplied batteries shall be inspected by the consignee/Board of Officers. - Physical condition, dimensions, weight, voltage and connector compatibility shall be verified. - Charging and discharging performance shall be checked as per OEM-prescribed procedures. - Battery health monitoring and cell balancing functionality shall be verified.

- Operational endurance and compatibility checks shall be conducted using the existing NETRA sys tem by authorised technical personnel. - Batteries not meeting the prescribed specifications shall be rejected as per contractual provision s. 7. Warranty - Minimum 12 months comprehensive warranty from the date of successful acceptance, subject to approva l in the procurement requirement. - The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and functional failures under normal operating c onditions. - Defective batteries shall be repaired or replaced without additional cost during the applicable wa rranty period. - Connector warranty shall be minimum one year. 8. Delivery and Packaging - Batteries shall be supplied in original protective packaging. - Each battery shall carry a unique serial number and manufacturing date. - Safe packaging, handling and transportation of lithium batteries shall be ensured. - Necessary charging, storage and handling instructions shall accompany the supply. 9. Replacement of Defective Material - Any battery found defective, damaged or technically non-compliant during inspection shall be replaced b y the seller without additional financial liability to the buyer. - Replacement shall be completed within 15 days of written notification, subject to contractual pro visions. 10. General Conditions - All applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions shall remain applicable. - Applicable Government procurement policies, including Make in India and MSE purchase preference, shall be followed. - Technical evaluation shall be based on compliance with the specifications and documented comp atibility with UAV NETRA. - The buyer reserves the right to reject non-conforming supplies in accordance with the contract a nd applicable GeM provisions. .
